Disabling preprocessing entirely preserves elements the standard preset would remove

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<nav>NavSection</nav><p>Paragraph</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: { 'enabled' => false }))
puts result.content.inspect
```
